[Addition / omission between witnesses] Adopted 'om.' [B (03), א (01), SRGNT, SBLGNT, Nestle1904, BHP] (weight 5.73, confidence 99%) over ἵνα κατηγορήσωσιν αὐτοῦ (RP2018 (Byz), TR (KJTR)). Also normalised 6 orthographic/surface variation(s).

analysis.note: Verse confidence 97% = product of 3 unit confidence(s); calibrated on the Greek NT (probability that a modern critical edition agrees, fitted with a whole stream of witnesses held out).
